operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Recomputes a requisition's stock movements and re-posts its accounting journals. Use it to re-synchronise a requisition's stock and journal entries after related data has changed.

The requisition must be in an **Accepted** or **Modified** status; otherwise nothing is updated and the response is `{"status": false, "errors": [ ... ]}`. On success the response is `{"status": true}`. Both outcomes are returned with HTTP 200.

200.description: The recompute result. Returns `{"status": true}` on success, or `{"status": false, "errors": [ ... ]}` when the requisition is not in an Accepted/Modified status. Both outcomes use HTTP 200.

status.description: `true` when the recompute ran; `false` when the requisition's status does not allow it.

errors.description: Present only when `status` is `false`. Explains why the requisition was not updated (e.g. it is not in an Accepted/Modified status).
